3.measure_note: legacy_colAB Schedule A is an UNDERLINE form, not a boxed grid. rowbands.py (200 dpi, raw frame, skew -0.1) returns 17 per-column underline rules at 21.71, 25.55, 29.36 ... 82.79 with a regular pitch of 3.82, each rule carrying 4 segments that ARE the column bands (Date 8.18-19.24, Name 20.77-52.38, Address 53.85-79.98, Amount 81.45-90.99). THE TEXT SITS ABOVE ITS UNDERLINE, so row N spans [rule N-1, rule N]; row 1 has no rule above it and its band is extrapolated one pitch up from the first detected rule (21.71 - 3.82 = 17.89). PROOF (900 dpi tight crops; this page has exactly ONE transcribed row so that row is proved on both axes): the amount box pct:81.45,17.89,9.54,3.82@p3 rendered the handwritten '400.00' sitting on its underline (recorded 400.00), and the date+name box pct:8.18,17.89,44.20,3.82@p3 rendered '9-7-10' and 'Utah County Republican Party' (recorded verbatim) — so the band is on the filled row, not the blank row below it.
